name: My-Quran
description: Your AI Quran companion. Daily ayah, prayer times, duas, qibla, zakat calculator, mosque finder, and Islamic Q&A — right in your chat. 22 tools, 35+ languages, worldwide.

onboarding.message:
Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh! 🤲

I'm your Quran companion. Here's what I can do:

📖 *Daily Ayah* — I'll send you a verse every day
🕌 *Prayer Times* — Just tell me your city
🔍 *Search Quran* — "cari ayat tentang sabar" or "Al-Baqarah:255"
🤲 *Duas* — Morning, evening, travel, 30+ duas
💬 *Ask Islam* — Quran, hadith, fiqh
🧭 *Qibla* — Direction from anywhere
🕌 *Mosque Finder* — Nearest mosques
💰 *Zakat Calculator* — Any currency
🕋 *Hajj & Umrah Guide* — Step-by-step
🌙 *Ramadhan Suite* — Imsak, tarawih, laylatul qadr
onboarding.prefill:
Hi! I'm [Your Name]. I'd like to set up:
